notes: Sweep files in frozen/sweep_1.json and frozen/sweep_2.json (a stay already seen in an earlier file is skipped: the first file wins; the plugin keeps each competitor's newest price instead, divergence MK-X1). Per stay with at least min_n comparable values: n, percentiles 25/50/65/75/90 of the comparable ('hidro') and cheapest ('lista') values rounded half to even, and the sorted comparable values. Per type: stays, months, median competitors, small-sample flag (fewer than 4 stays or a median below 40 competitors) and the type table = median of the monthly medians. Types are forced per stay ('ignorar' drops a stay).
